originalTitle: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
title: Missing Moms and Dads: A Search for Answers in Africa!
content:
Hello, amazing explorers and wonderful friends! It's your friendly Reporter Roar, here to share a very important story from our big, beautiful home, Africa. Today, we're going to talk about something that happened a long, long time ago, in a country called Eritrea. It's a bit sad, but it's also about a lot of hope and love!

Parents Who Went Missing

Imagine if your mom or dad went to work one day, and then they didn't come home. And then, you waited, and waited, and waited. Not just for a day, or a week, but for 25 whole years! That's a super, super long time. It's longer than you've been alive, and probably longer than your teachers have been teaching! This is what happened to some children in Eritrea. Their moms and dads were very important people called "politicians." A politician is someone who helps run a country and make good rules for everyone. They work to make life better for all the people. A long, long time ago, about 25 years ago, these important politician parents were put in a place called jail. But the really, really sad thing is, no one knows exactly where they went, or even why. It's a big mystery that has lasted for so many years. Did you know? 25 years is a whole quarter of a century! That's a super long time, like when your parents were just little kids, maybe even babies!

Growing Up Without Answers

Now, the little children of those missing parents are not little anymore. They are big grown-ups! Some of them even have their own children. But even though they are grown-ups, they still miss their moms and dads very, very much. They carry this sadness and lots of questions in their hearts every single day. One of these grown-up children shared how they feel, saying, "I don't even know if my parents are alive." Imagine how hard that must be! It means they don't know if their mom or dad is still living and breathing in the world. They wonder if they are safe, if they are warm, and if they think about their children. It's like having a big, important piece of your family puzzle missing. And you can't finish the puzzle until you find that piece. These grown-up children have lived their whole lives wondering what happened to the people they love most. Did you know? When someone is "jailed," it means they are kept in a special building, like a prison, where they cannot leave. Sometimes people are jailed for breaking rules, but sometimes it happens unfairly, and that's not right.

Searching for the Truth

These grown-up children want to find out the truth. They want to know what happened to their parents 25 years ago. It's like a big detective story they are trying to solve. They are asking the people who lead Eritrea now to help them. They want to know: Where are our parents? Are they okay? Or, if something sad happened, please tell us. Knowing the truth, even if it's not the happiest news, can sometimes help a heart feel a little bit better. It helps people understand what happened and start to heal. They just want to know their story. Did you know? Everyone in the world has a human right to know what happened to their family members if they disappear. It's a very important right!

A Little About Eritrea

Eritrea is a beautiful country in Africa. It's on the east side of our amazing continent, right by a beautiful blue sea called the Red Sea. It has sunny weather, lovely mountains, and busy cities. People there speak a language called Tigrinya and Arabic. Africa is a continent full of many different countries, cultures, and amazing animals. Eritrea is just one of its sparkling jewels. Did you know? Africa is the second-biggest continent in the whole wide world! It's so big and full of different landscapes, from deserts to rainforests.

Why This Story Matters to All of Us

This story reminds us that every single person is important. Everyone deserves to be treated fairly and kindly. When someone disappears, it's very, very sad for their whole family and for everyone who cares about them. These children, who are now grown-ups, are showing us how strong love can be. Even after 25 years, they never stopped loving their parents and wanting to know what happened. They are very brave to keep asking for answers and speaking up. They want justice, which means things being fair and right. And they want peace in their hearts, which comes from knowing the truth.

Hope for the Future

We hope that one day soon, these grown-up children will finally get the answers they need. We hope their hearts can find some peace. Maybe, just maybe, they will even get to see their parents again, or at least know exactly what happened to them. Let's send them lots of good thoughts and wishes from our hearts. It's important to remember that kindness and truth are very powerful. Let's hope for a happy ending to this long, long search for answers!
summary: Children of important leaders in Eritrea are still searching for answers about their parents who disappeared and were put in jail 25 years ago, hoping to finally know what happened to them.
whyMatters: This story is important because everyone deserves to know what happened to their family, and it shows how strong love can be even after a very long time, as these grown-up children bravely search for truth and fairness.

originalTitle: 'Enough is enough': Women protest after string of murders near Johannesburg
title: Strong Voices for a Safer Community!
content:
Hi everyone! It's your friend, Sunny, reporting live from our amazing continent, Africa! Today, we're talking about something important that happened near a big city called Johannesburg. It's about how people are working together to keep everyone safe and happy. Let's learn together!

What Happened? Grown-ups Speak Up for Safety!

Imagine you want to tell everyone something very important. Sometimes, grown-ups do this by having a 'protest'. A protest is when many people come together to show how they feel about something. They might hold signs or sing songs. It's like when you tell your teacher that you really, really want more playtime, but many grown-ups do it all at once! Near Johannesburg, some brave women recently had a protest. They said 'Enough is enough!' This means they felt very strongly that some things that were making people sad and scared needed to stop. They want everyone in their community to feel safe when they walk outside. They want to be able to go to the shop or visit friends without worrying. Isn't it wonderful when people come together to help each other? **Did you know?** The word "protest" comes from an old word that means "to declare publicly." So, people are publicly saying what they believe!

Where is Johannesburg? Our Big City!

Johannesburg is a super big and busy city in a country called South Africa. South Africa is right at the bottom of our continent, Africa! It has tall buildings, lots of cars, and many, many people living and working there. It’s a bit like a giant anthill, but with people instead of ants! Can you imagine how many stories a city like that holds? Near Johannesburg, there's an area called Kempton Park. This is where our story is happening. Kempton Park is like a neighborhood or a town next to the big city. Just like your street or your town, people live there, go to school, and play. **Did you know?** Johannesburg is often called "Jozi" for short! It's one of the biggest cities in all of Africa!

Meet the Police Task Team!

When something important needs to be sorted out, we often call on special helpers. In this story, the police are those helpers! The police are like the guardians of our communities. Their job is to keep everyone safe, make sure rules are followed, and help when there are problems. The police heard what the women were saying. So, they decided to set up something very important called a 'task team'. A task team is like a special group of detectives and police officers. They all work together on one big problem. They are like a super-squad trying to solve a puzzle! Their job is to 'investigate'. To investigate means to look very, very closely at all the clues. They talk to people, look for signs, and try to understand everything that happened. They want to find out what went wrong and make sure it doesn't happen again. It's a very serious and important job, don't you think? **Did you know?** Police officers wear uniforms so you can easily spot them if you need help!

Staying Safe: Tips for Everyone!

The police also shared some really good advice for everyone in Kempton Park, and it's good advice for all of us too! They said it's a good idea to not walk or run alone, especially in 'isolated areas'. What are isolated areas? These are places where there aren't many people around. Maybe a quiet path, a very empty park, or a street that doesn't have many houses. It's like when you play hide-and-seek and find a really good, quiet hiding spot – but this time, it’s not for playing! So, what can we do? * **Buddy System!** Try to always walk with a friend, a brother, a sister, or a grown-up. Just like you go to the shop with a parent, it's safer to have someone with you. * **Busy Paths!** Try to choose paths where there are lots of other people around. More people mean more eyes to help if someone needs it. * **Tell a Grown-Up!** If you are going somewhere, always tell a grown-up where you are going and who you are with. * **Stay Alert!** Always look around you and be aware of your surroundings. Don't be too busy looking at your phone to notice what's happening around you. * **Bright is Best!** If you must go out when it's getting dark, wear bright clothes so cars and people can see you easily. (Though it's always best to be home before it gets dark!) **Did you know?** Many animals in the wild also travel in groups or with their families to stay safe!

Why Is This Important? We Are All One Community!

This story shows us how important it is for everyone in a community to look out for each other. When something bad happens, it doesn't just affect one person; it affects everyone around them. That's why the women stood up – because they care about their neighbors, their friends, and their families. It's like when someone in your class needs help with their homework, and you or your teacher helps them. We are all part of a big team, and we want everyone on the team to be safe and happy. When grown-ups protest, they are asking for help and for things to be better for everyone. It shows they have big, caring hearts! **Did you know?** Communities all around the world have special days where everyone comes together to help clean up or fix things in their neighborhood!

What Can Kids Do? Be Super Helpers!

Even though you are small, you can be a super helper too! * **Listen to Grown-ups:** Always listen to your parents, teachers, and other grown-ups when they tell you how to stay safe. * **Walk with Friends:** If you walk to school or to a friend's house, try to go with a buddy. * **If You Feel Unsafe:** If you ever feel scared or unsafe, run to a trusted grown-up (like a parent, teacher, or police officer) and tell them right away. * **Look Out for Each Other:** If you see a friend alone and they look sad or worried, go tell a grown-up. We all need to be kind and watchful. Remember, it's okay to ask for help, and it's okay to tell a grown-up if something doesn't feel right. Your voice is important!

Bringing Safety Home!

So, there you have it! A big story about strong women, brave police, and how a community is working together to make sure everyone feels safe and loved. Our amazing continent of Africa is full of wonderful people who care deeply about each other. Let's all remember to be kind, be watchful, and always stay safe. And if you ever need help, remember there are always trusted grown-ups ready to listen and protect you. That's all from me, Sunny, your kid-friendly reporter! Keep smiling, keep learning, and keep helping each other!
summary: Brave women near the big city of Johannesburg are speaking up for safety, and the police are working hard to keep everyone protected.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows how everyone in a community can work together to make sure all people, especially women and children, feel safe and happy when they are out and about.

originalTitle: Trump tariffs hit Canada’s dairy farmers as US sales stall
title: Moo-ving Trouble: A Milk Story from Canada!
content:
Hello, Little News Explorers!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter for Africa, ready to tell you an interesting story from far, far away. Today, we're going on an adventure to a big, beautiful country called Canada. Imagine a place with lots of snow, vast forests, and friendly people! But guess what? Even in such a lovely place, sometimes things can get a little tricky, especially for farmers who work with milk!

What's Going On With Milk in Canada?

Our story today is about Canadian farmers and their happy cows. These farmers work hard every single day to get fresh, yummy milk. Just like we might have farmers here in Africa who grow maize or millet, farmers in Canada often look after cows. They collect the milk, and then they sell it so we can all enjoy delicious things like milk, cheese, and yogurt! But recently, something happened that made it hard for them to sell all their milk. They ended up with too much!

Meet Our Cow Friends!

Think about a big, gentle cow. What do they do? They eat grass, relax in the fields, and give us milk! Farmers are like their best friends, making sure they are healthy and happy. Every morning and every evening, the cows are milked. This milk is very important because it helps children grow strong, just like you! Did you know? A cow can give about 25 to 30 litres of milk every single day! That's a lot of milk, enough to fill many bottles for your family!

What Are These "Tariffs" Anyway? (The Extra Coin Rule!)

Now, here's the tricky part of our story: "tariffs." That's a big, funny word, right? Let's make it super simple. Imagine you have a friend who lives next door. You made some delicious cookies, and your friend wants to buy some from you. But then, your mom says, "Okay, your friend can buy the cookies, but they have to pay an extra two coins for each cookie because it's coming from *your* kitchen, not *our* kitchen!" That extra two coins is like a "tariff." It's a special extra money payment that one country asks for when another country wants to sell something to them. So, if Canada wants to sell milk to another country, that other country might say, "Okay, but you have to pay us an extra fee for every carton of milk you send." This makes the milk more expensive for the people buying it.

Mr. Trump and His Country

In our story, the country that asked for this "extra coin" on Canadian milk was the United States. The United States is a very big country right next to Canada. And the person who was the leader of the United States at that time was a man named Mr. Trump. Leaders of countries make rules about how their country works and how it trades with other countries. Mr. Trump's government decided to put a big "extra coin" – a 50 percent tariff – on milk that came from Canadian farmers into the United States. Did you know? Countries are like big families. They have neighbours, just like you might have neighbours next door! Canada and the United States are neighbours.

A Big Problem for Farmers

Before this new rule, Canadian farmers used to send lots and lots of their fresh milk to the United States. People in the United States loved buying Canadian milk! But when the United States asked for that big "extra coin" (the 50 percent tariff), Canadian milk suddenly became much, much more expensive. Imagine if your favourite sweet became twice as expensive – you might not buy as much, right? That's what happened with the milk! People in the United States stopped buying as much milk from Canada because it was just too costly. This meant that the Canadian farmers, who were working so hard, suddenly had too much milk! They had collected all this milk from their happy cows, expecting to sell it, but now many of their usual buyers were gone. It's like baking a hundred birthday cakes for a party, and then only five friends show up!

Why Can't They Just Sell It Somewhere Else?

You might be thinking, "Why don't they just sell the milk to someone else or turn it into cheese?" That's a great question! Farmers are very clever, and they do try to find other buyers. But here's the thing: milk is fresh, and it doesn't last forever. It can go bad if it's not sold or used quickly. Also, cows give milk every single day, so farmers always have a fresh supply. It's not easy to suddenly change where you send all that milk overnight. It takes time to find new customers, new factories to turn milk into cheese or yogurt, or new ways to store it. So, when the sales to the United States stopped so suddenly, the farmers were left with a big problem: too much milk and no quick place to send it. Did you know? Milk can be made into so many yummy things! Like cheese, butter, ice cream, and yogurt!

What Happens Now?

When farmers have too much milk and can't sell it, they can lose a lot of money. This can make them very sad because they work so hard to care for their cows and produce good food. They might have to look for new countries to sell their milk to, or try to encourage more people in Canada to buy extra milk or milk products. It’s a bit like when you try to find a new game to play when your old game is broken – it takes a little while to figure out.

Learning From Far Away Friends!

So, even though this story is happening very far away in Canada, it teaches us something important. It shows us how countries talk to each other, how rules can change things for people, and how much hard work farmers do. Every country, including our beautiful countries here in Africa, trades with others. Sometimes these trades are easy, and sometimes they get a little bumpy. We learn that farmers, everywhere in the world, are important because they help feed us all. And when they face problems, it's good for us to understand why. Hopefully, the Canadian farmers found new homes for all their delicious milk! Did you know? There are many types of cows all over the world, even right here in Africa! Some give milk, and some are raised for meat. Farmers are super important people!
summary: Canadian farmers faced a big problem when the United States put an extra fee, called a tariff, on their milk, making it hard to sell and leaving them with too much milk.
whyMatters: This story helps us understand how rules between countries can affect farmers and the food we eat, showing that even far away, choices can make a big difference for many people.

originalTitle: Who rated highest in Fulham v Man Utd?
title: Our African Football Adventure: A Super Goal in England!
content:
Hello, My Little Football Friends!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly African news reporter here, ready to tell you about some super exciting football news! We all love football, don't we? It's a game where brave players run very fast and kick a round ball to score goals. It makes our hearts beat super fast with joy! Today, we have a story from a big football game far away in a country called England. Imagine a giant green field and lots of cheering people!

What is Football, Really?

Football is a game played between two teams. Each team has 11 players. The goal is to kick the ball into the other team's net. This is called scoring a "goal"! The team that scores more goals wins the game. It's a game of speed, skill, and lots of teamwork. Everyone needs to work together to be the best!

The Big Match Day!

Last weekend, two big football teams played a very important game. One team was called Manchester United. They wear red shirts! The other team was called Fulham. They wear white and black shirts! Imagine all the fans in the stadium, shouting and clapping for their favourite players. It was a very exciting day for everyone who loves football!

Meet Manchester United!

Manchester United is a very famous football team from England. Lots of children all over the world, even here in Africa, know about them! They have many super players. They try their best to win every game they play. They are known for playing with lots of spirit and never giving up, even when the game is tough.

And Who are Fulham?

Fulham is another good team from England. They might not be as famous as Manchester United, but they are strong! They also play with lots of heart. They wanted to win this game very much. Every team dreams of beating a big team like Manchester United. They showed they are very brave and can play amazing football too!

The Game Begins!

The referee blew his whistle, and the game started! Both teams ran onto the big green field. The players passed the ball to each other. They tried to kick it towards the goal. The fans cheered very loudly with every kick and every save. It was like a dance with the football! Everyone was watching closely, holding their breath.

Did you know?

A football field is called a pitch! It is usually made of green grass. It is very long, like many classrooms put together! Players run many kilometers during one game. That's why they need to be very fit and strong! They train every single day to be super speedy.

Exciting Moments on the Field!

The game was going back and forth. First, Manchester United would attack, trying to score. Then, Fulham would get the ball and run to the other side, trying to score their own goal! Both teams were playing so well. The goalkeepers were jumping and diving to stop the ball from going into their nets. It was like a thrilling adventure happening right before their eyes!

Time Was Running Out!

The clock kept ticking, tick-tock, tick-tock. The game was almost finished. It looked like neither team would score a goal. This would mean a "draw," where no one wins. Many fans were getting a little sad because they wanted to see a winner. The players were getting tired but they kept running and trying their best.

What is a "Last Minute" Goal?

Sometimes, something amazing happens right at the very end of the game. This is called a "last minute" goal! It means a player scores when there are only a few seconds or minutes left to play. It is very exciting and makes everyone jump up and down! It can change the whole game in a flash, turning sadness into pure joy for one team.

Cunha the Hero!

And guess what happened? Just when everyone thought the game was over, a player from Manchester United called Cunha did something wonderful! He got the ball, dribbled past some defenders, and with a powerful kick, he sent the ball flying! Swish! It went straight into the net! A GOAL! A fantastic, amazing, last-minute goal!

Saving the Day!

This super goal by Cunha was very, very important. It "saved" Manchester United from another "defeat." What does that mean? A defeat means to lose the game. So, Cunha's goal meant Manchester United did not lose. Instead, the game ended in a draw, which is much better than losing! It felt like a win for them because they almost lost everything.

Did you know?

The referee is the person who makes sure all the players follow the rules. He wears a special uniform and has a whistle. If a player breaks a rule, the referee blows the whistle and can show a yellow card or even a red card. He helps to make sure the game is fair for everyone!

Who Played the Best at Fulham?

Now, after the game, people always talk about which players played the best. This is called "rating" the players. They ask, "Who rated highest?" For Fulham, even though they didn't win, one player really stood out. Many people thought their goalkeeper was incredibly brave! He made so many fantastic saves, stopping many shots from Manchester United. He was like a superhero guarding his goal!

The Goalkeeper's Super Power!

A goalkeeper's job is super important. They are the last line of defense! They have to be very quick and brave to stop the ball. Fulham's goalkeeper jumped, dived, and used his hands and feet to block the ball many times. He showed everyone how strong and agile he was. He truly played his heart out for his team.

Teamwork Makes the Dream Work!

Even though Cunha scored the big goal for Manchester United, and Fulham's goalkeeper played so well, football is always about teamwork. Every player on the field, from the defenders to the strikers, works together. They pass the ball, they defend, they cheer each other on. That's why football is such a wonderful game! Together, they are stronger.

Did you know?

A football player usually runs between 8 to 12 kilometers in one game! That's like running from your home to a far-away market! They need lots of energy and water to keep going. They are truly athletes and superstars!

Why We Love Football!

Football teaches us many good things. It teaches us about working together, never giving up, and being fair. Even when a game ends in a draw, or if a team loses, they learn and try harder next time. It's not just about winning; it's about playing with joy and respecting each other. So, let's keep cheering for our favourite teams! Maybe one day, you will be a football star too! Keep practicing your kicks!
summary: In a thrilling football match, a player named Cunha scored a goal for Manchester United right at the very end, which stopped them from losing to Fulham, and many praised Fulham's brave goalkeeper for his amazing performance.
whyMatters: This story shows us that in football, exciting things can happen until the very last second, and even when a team almost loses, they can still find a way to make it better, teaching us to never give up.
